rules:
- id: "vuln-aiohttp-1c335944"
  pattern: |
    if $CONDITION:
        $PATH = $DIRECTORY.joinpath($FILENAME).resolve()
        if not $FOLLOW_SYMLINKS:
            $PATH = $DIRECTORY.joinpath($FILENAME).resolve()
  pattern-not: |
    if $CONDITION:
        $PATH = $DIRECTORY.joinpath($FILENAME)
        if $FOLLOW_SYMLINKS:
            $PATH = Path(os.path.normpath($PATH)).relative_to($DIRECTORY).resolve()
        else:
            $PATH = $DIRECTORY.joinpath($FILENAME).resolve()
  languages: ["python"]
  message: "Directory traversal vulnerability in aiohttp static file handling. When follow_symlinks=True, attackers can access files outside the intended directory."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp/commit/1c335944d6a8b1298baf179b7c0b3069f10c514b
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-22
    owasp: A1:2021-Broken Access Control
    references:
      - https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/2021/A1_2021-Broken_Access_Control
      - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html
    technology: [python]
